# @jewel998/config

> Free, self-hosted feature flag and remote configuration SDK. Replaces LaunchDarkly at $0/month. Runs entirely on Firebase free tier.

## Links

- [Documentation](https://jewel998.github.io/config/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/jewel998/config)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@jewel998/config)
- [Full LLM Documentation](https://jewel998.github.io/config/llms-full.txt)

## Install

```
npm install @jewel998/config
```

## Quick Start (Client-side / Frontend)

```typescript
import { initConfig, autoContext } from "@jewel998/config";

const flags = initConfig({
  clientId: "cid_xxx",           // From Portal → API Keys
  baseUrl: "https://your-project.web.app/api",
  defaults: {
    "feature.dark_mode": false,
    "app.upload_limit": 50,
  },
  context: autoContext({ userId: "user_123", plan: "pro" }),
});

// Instant read — returns default before API responds
flags.get("feature.dark_mode"); // → false

// After API resolves
flags.on("updated", () => {
  flags.get("feature.dark_mode"); // → true
});
```

## Quick Start (Server-side / Backend)

```typescript
import { createConfig } from "@jewel998/config";
import { targetingPlugin } from "@jewel998/config/targeting";
import { rolloutPlugin } from "@jewel998/config/rollout";

const config = createConfig({
  clientId: "svr_xxx",
  baseUrl: "https://your-project.web.app/api",
  plugins: [targetingPlugin(), rolloutPlugin()],
  context: { userId: "user_123", attributes: { plan: "pro", country: "US" } },
});

config.getFlag("feature.checkout_v2"); // Evaluated locally
```

## API Key Types

- `cid_` prefix = Client key (frontend). API evaluates server-side, returns only values.
- `svr_` prefix = Server key (backend). Returns full flag data for local evaluation.

## Core API

### initConfig(options) → Flags

Primary entry point. Returns instant defaults, resolves to real values.

Options:
- clientId (string, required) — API key from Portal
- baseUrl (string) — Your Firebase API URL
- defaults (Record<string, any>) — Fallback values
- context (EvaluationContext) — User targeting context
- pollInterval (number, default 300000) — Version poll interval ms
- storage (CacheStorage) — Cache adapter

### Flags methods

- flags.get(key) — Get a flag value
- flags.flag(key) — Get boolean flag
- flags.all() — Get all values
- flags.setContext(ctx) — Update context, triggers re-fetch
- flags.refresh() — Force re-fetch
- flags.on(event, cb) / flags.off(event, cb) — Event subscription

### createConfig(options) → ConfigClient

Advanced entry point with plugins and loading strategies.

Additional options:
- loadingStrategy ("optimistic" | "pessimistic" | "deferred")
- fetchGranularity ("batch" | "projected")
- plugins (EvaluationPlugin[])
- retry (RetryConfig)
- timeout (number)
- consentAware (boolean) — GDPR mode

### ConfigClient methods

- config.getValue(key, default?) — Typed value
- config.getFlag(key) — Boolean flag
- config.getAll() — All key-value pairs
- config.refresh() — Version-gated re-fetch
- config.setContext(ctx) — Update context
- config.on/off(event, cb) — Events
- config.destroy() — Cleanup timers and state

## Package Exports

- @jewel998/config — Main SDK (initConfig, createConfig, autoContext)
- @jewel998/config/server — Server utilities
- @jewel998/config/storage — Memory storage adapter
- @jewel998/config/targeting — Targeting evaluation plugin
- @jewel998/config/rollout — Percentage rollout plugin
- @jewel998/config/schedule — Scheduling plugin
- @jewel998/config/prerequisites — Flag prerequisites plugin
- @jewel998/config/lifecycle — Lifecycle hooks plugin
- @jewel998/config/overrides — Local overrides plugin
- @jewel998/config/management — Management API client

## Events

- "ready" — SDK initialized
- "updated" — Config values changed
- "fetchError" — Fetch failed (SDK never throws)
- "revoked" — API key revoked

## Self-Hosting

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jewel998/config && cd config
firebase use --add your-project-id
pnpm install && firebase deploy
```

Runs on Firebase Spark (free) tier for up to 50K+ users.

## Features

- Feature flags (boolean, string, number, JSON, array)
- User targeting rules by attributes
- Reusable segments (audience groups)
- Percentage rollouts with deterministic bucketing
- Flag prerequisites with operators
- Scheduled config changes
- Multiple environments (dev/staging/production)
- Audit log with diff viewer
- Webhooks (Slack, Discord, Teams, custom)
- RBAC (Viewer, Editor, Admin)
- Server-side evaluation (rules never exposed to client)
- Circuit breaker and retry logic built-in
- Version-gated polling (minimal bandwidth)
